title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil drafter or junior civil designer (Melbourne)
content_text: AT&L careers page: 'We're growing across North Sydney, Parramatta, Brisbane, and Melbourne ... If that sounds like you, send your CV and cover letter to hr@atl.net.au.' Roles described: Civil Drafters ('bring projects to life through precise, high-quality documentation'), Civil Engineers, Civil Designers / Civil Design Engineers, Structural Engineers, Surveyors, Water Servicing Coordinators. Melbourne office: Level 4, 50 Market Street, Melbourne VIC 3000 (get-in-touch page). Melbourne project: Amaroo Business Park, Craigieburn VIC, 50 ha greenfield industrial subdivision for Goodman; AT&L designed all civil elements including roads, stormwater drainage, earthworks and retaining walls, with site-based staff completing construction-phase contract administration. Team page: Joshua Barnett, Civil Design Manager for Melbourne; Kunjan Patel, Manager - Melbourne. No numbered vacancy listed.
apply_instructions: Email hr@atl.net.au (published on the careers page as the address for CV and cover letter).
